title: Historic gold dredging damaged a California river used by salmon and steelhead
summary_full: Major funding has been secured for restoration initiatives aimed at revitalizing the salmon habitat along the Tuolumne River. The project will reestablish 20 acres at La Grange, improving conditions for salmon and steelhead. With new side channels and a historic floodplain, the area will become conducive for salmon spawning. Collaborative efforts by various organizations since 2020 highlight an ongoing dedication to ecological preservation in this region.
